pages.about: Verity Athletics supplies training equipment to schools, colleges and sports clubs. We quote against tender documents, hold stock for framework agreements, and deliver on a schedule agreed at the start of each academic year.
pages.refund_policy: Returns accepted within 30 days of delivery in unused condition with original packaging. Bespoke and printed items are non-returnable unless faulty. Institutional accounts may return within 60 days by prior arrangement.
pages.shipping_policy: Standard delivery on items under 20kg is $12.00, arriving in 3-5 business days. Large equipment ships on a two-person pallet service with a lead time of 7-14 business days, quoted at order.
